description: This Java source file implements the LoanArrearsAgingService for managing and updating loan arrears aging details. It includes methods for calculating arrears, updating schedules, and listening for relevant business events to trigger these updates.

classes.name: LoanArrearsAgingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanArrearsAgingService interface, responsible for managing loan arrears aging, schedule updates, and event-driven recalculations.

methods.name: registerForNotification
methods.description: Registers various business event listeners to handle loan arrears updates upon specific loan-related events.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Updates the arrears aging details for a loan based on its original repayment schedule.

methods.name: getScheduleDate
methods.description: Retrieves the schedule date data for a given loan ID.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetails
methods.description: Updates or deletes the arrears aging details for a specific loan.

methods.name: calculateArrearsForLoan
methods.description: Calculates the overdue amounts for principal, interest, fees, and penalties based on the loan's repayment schedule.

methods.name: constructUpdateStatement
methods.description: Constructs SQL update or insert statements based on arrears calculation results.

methods.name: getLoanSummary
methods.description: Gathers a summary of loan repayments, interest waiver, fees paid, etc., for arrears calculation.

methods.name: createInsertStatements
methods.description: Creates SQL insert or update statements for the arrears aging table based on schedule data.

methods.name: constructInsertStatement
methods.description: Builds an SQL insert statement for the arrears data.

methods.name: constructUpdateStatement
methods.description: Builds an SQL update statement for the arrears data.

methods.name: updateScheduleWithPaidDetail
methods.description: Updates the repayment schedule data with paid amounts and waivers.
